Name: Earthy Retexture 'Forge - Craft Your Own Equipment'
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

This is just a retexture of the forge buildings in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24813]Forge - Craft Your Own Equipment[/url]﻿ mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/138767638]dollynhoevida[/url] to match the Earthy palette or really any desaturated recolor. This is a replacer mod so it replaces the images of the forge's located in the original mod

Let me know if there's any bugs

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a replacer mod so it replaces the original mod's building .pngs - I've setup the mod to match the original mod's folder structure so you will only need to drag and drop it over the original mod's folder and it will only replace the forge images
 [list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod


[*]Drag an drop into your Mods folder, or whichever subfolder the ' [CP] Forge' mod is located


[*]After dragging and dropping the mod, you should recieve a pop-up to replace the assets already located - click yes


[*]You're done!



[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]
Thank you[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/138767638]dollynhoevida[/url] for giving me permission to release this patch ^-^ I'm excited to see how the original mod develops: Checkout the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24813]Main Mod[/url]﻿

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour [/url]﻿mod which I took inspo of to create this retexture

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
